statement: Nebius AI Cloud generated $575 million of revenue in Q2 2026, up 514% year over year, with total Nebius Group revenue up 454%.
why: Realized cloud revenue growing five-fold shows accelerator capacity is being sold and consumed, not just installed, which is the strongest confirmation that rental demand is real.

impact.mechanism: Rapid growth in AI cloud revenue funds and justifies further GPU fleet purchases by the operator.

evidence.source: KuCoin News (flash article), corroborated by Futu News
evidence.excerpt: Nebius AI Cloud segment specifically generated $575 million in quarterly revenue, a 514% year-over-year increase.

confidence.basis: Reported quarterly results restated in a secondary flash article; the underlying Nebius filing was not read here.

dispersion: Group revenue +454% year over year versus AI Cloud segment +514%.
